title: Admin - Add Internal Admin - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin User & Role Management - Add Internal Admin feature on the Y4J platform. This feature allows Super Admins to add new internal administrators via a modal form with Name, Email, and Role fields, a permissions section, and an 'Add Admin' submit button. The new admin should appear in the list immediately after creation. Covers happy path, form validation, edge cases, error handling, and modal behavior.

testCases.title: Clicking 'Add Internal Admin' button opens the modal
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. User & Roles page is loaded.
steps: Locate the 'Add Internal Admin' button in the toolbar
expectedResults: The 'Add Internal Admin' button is visible in the toolbar area
Clicking the button opens a modal/dialog
The modal contains form fields for Name, Email, and Role
The modal has a title/heading indicating its purpose
The background is dimmed/overlaid while modal is open
testCases.postconditions: Add Internal Admin modal is open and ready for input

testCases.title: Modal contains Name, Email, and Role fields
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Observe the form fields present in the modal
expectedResults: A 'Name' text input field is present
An 'Email' text input field is present
A 'Role' selection field is present (dropdown or radio buttons)
Role options include 'Super Admin' and 'Limited-Access Admin'
All fields have visible labels
testCases.postconditions: All required form fields are visible in the modal

testCases.title: Permissions section becomes available after role selection
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
expectedResults: After selecting a role, a permissions section appears or becomes enabled
The permissions section shows checkboxes for available modules (Dashboard, User Management, Partner Management, Product Management, Comment Moderation, Content Management, Analytics)
For 'Limited-Access Admin', individual permissions can be selected/deselected
For 'Super Admin', all permissions may be pre-selected and locked
testCases.postconditions: Permissions section is visible and interactive

testCases.title: Successfully add a new admin with all valid fields
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open. The email to be used does not already exist.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Select at least one permission (e.g., 'Dashboard', 'Partner Management')
expectedResults: The form submits successfully without errors
A success message or notification is displayed
The modal closes after successful submission
The new admin appears in the admin list immediately
The new admin card shows the correct name, email, role, and permissions
testCases.postconditions: New admin is created and visible in the admin list

testCases.title: New admin appears in the admin list immediately after creation
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. A new admin has just been created.
steps: Create a new admin via the Add Internal Admin modal
After modal closes, observe the admin list
Verify the new admin card is present
expectedResults: The admin list updates without requiring a page refresh
The new admin card is visible in the list
The admin count ('Showing X admins') increments by 1
The new admin card displays: name, email, role, status (Active), assigned date (today), assigned by (current user), and selected permissions
testCases.postconditions: New admin is confirmed in the list with correct details

testCases.title: Duplicate email shows error and prevents submission
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. An admin with email 'aofted@mailto.plus' already exists.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Enter an email that already exists (e.g., 'aofted@mailto.plus')
expectedResults: The form does NOT submit successfully
An error message is displayed indicating the email is already in use (e.g., 'This email is already associated with an admin account')
The modal remains open for the user to correct the input
No duplicate admin is created in the list
testCases.postconditions: Duplicate email is rejected with clear error message

testCases.title: Invalid email format shows validation error
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Click 'Add Admin' or tab out of the email field
expectedResults: An inline validation error is displayed for the email field
Error message indicates invalid email format (e.g., 'Please enter a valid email address')
The form does NOT submit with invalid email
The email field is highlighted as invalid
testCases.postconditions: Invalid email is rejected with validation error

testCases.title: Empty name field shows validation error
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Enter a valid email and select a role
expectedResults: A validation error is displayed for the Name field
Error message indicates the name is required (e.g., 'Name is required')
The form does NOT submit with empty name
The Name field is highlighted as invalid
testCases.postconditions: Empty name is rejected with validation error

testCases.title: Admin creation API failure shows error notification
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open. API is configured to fail (or network issue simulated).
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Fill in all fields with valid data
expectedResults: An error notification is displayed (e.g., 'Failed to create admin. Please try again.')
The modal remains open so the user can retry
No partial/corrupt admin record is created
The user can attempt submission again after the error
testCases.postconditions: API failure is handled gracefully with user notification

testCases.title: Modal closed before submission does not create admin
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open with data entered.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Enter name, email, and select role
Close the modal without clicking 'Add Admin' (click X, press Escape, or click outside)
expectedResults: The modal closes without submitting the form
No new admin is created in the list
The admin count remains unchanged
No error messages are shown
The entered data is discarded (not saved as draft)
testCases.postconditions: No admin is created when modal is closed without submission

testCases.title: Add admin with Super Admin role
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
expectedResults: When 'Super Admin' role is selected, all permissions are automatically assigned
The admin is created successfully
The new admin card shows 'Super Admin' role
All permissions are displayed on the card (Dashboard, User Management, Partner Management, Product Management, Comment Moderation, Content Management, Analytics)
testCases.postconditions: Super Admin is created with full permissions

testCases.title: Add admin with Limited-Access Admin role and specific permissions
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Select specific permissions (e.g., only 'Dashboard' and 'Partner Management')
expectedResults: The admin is created successfully with only the selected permissions
The new admin card shows 'Limited Access Admin' role
Only the selected permissions are displayed on the card
Unselected permissions are NOT shown on the card
testCases.postconditions: Limited-Access Admin is created with specific permissions only

testCases.title: Cannot submit form without selecting at least one permission
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
expectedResults: The form does NOT submit
A validation error indicates at least one permission must be selected
The modal remains open for correction
The 'Add Admin' button may be disabled until a permission is selected
testCases.postconditions: Form requires at least one permission for Limited-Access Admin

testCases.title: Modal can be closed via X button
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Click the X (close) button on the modal
expectedResults: The modal closes
No admin is created
Focus returns to the 'Add Internal Admin' button or the page
testCases.postconditions: Modal is closed via X button

testCases.title: Modal can be closed via Escape key
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Press the Escape key on the keyboard
expectedResults: The modal closes
No admin is created
No errors occur
testCases.postconditions: Modal is closed via Escape key

testCases.title: Name field accepts valid characters
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Enter name with alphabetic characters (e.g., 'John Doe')
expectedResults: Alphabetic names are accepted
Names with numbers are accepted (or rejected with clear message if not allowed)
Names with common special characters (apostrophe, hyphen) are accepted
The field does not crash or break with any input
testCases.postconditions: Name field handles various character types correctly

testCases.title: Email field validates format in real-time
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Type 'test' in the email field and tab out
expectedResults: 'test' shows validation error (no @ symbol)
'test@' shows validation error (incomplete domain)
'test@domain' may show error or be accepted depending on validation rules
'test@domain.com' is accepted as valid email format
Validation feedback appears inline near the field
testCases.postconditions: Email validation provides real-time feedback

testCases.title: Assigned date and assigned by are set automatically
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin (pv@mailto.plus). A new admin has been created.
steps: Create a new admin via the Add Internal Admin modal
Observe the new admin card in the list
Check the 'Assigned' date and 'Assigned By' fields
expectedResults: The 'Assigned' date shows today's date (e.g., '2026-05-25')
The 'Assigned By' shows the current Super Admin's email (e.g., 'pv@mailto.plus')
These fields are set automatically — not entered by the user in the form
testCases.postconditions: Assignment metadata is automatically populated

testCases.title: New admin status is set to Active by default
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. A new admin has been created.
steps: Create a new admin via the Add Internal Admin modal
Observe the new admin card in the list
expectedResults: The new admin's status is automatically set to 'Active'
The status is not a field in the creation form — it's set by the system
The 'Active' status is visible on the admin card
testCases.postconditions: New admin has Active status by default

testCases.title: Add Admin button is disabled until required fields are filled
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Super Admin. Add Internal Admin modal is open with all fields empty.
steps: Open the Add Internal Admin modal
Observe the 'Add Admin' button state with all fields empty
Fill in the Name field only
Observe the button state after all fields are filled
expectedResults: With empty fields, the 'Add Admin' button is disabled or shows validation on click
As required fields are filled, the button becomes enabled
OR the button is always enabled but shows validation errors on click when fields are empty
The form clearly indicates which fields are required
testCases.postconditions: Form submission is gated by required field completion
